newsitem.title: THAILAND: RESEARCH ALERT - Seamico rates NTS a sell.
newsitem.headline: RESEARCH ALERT - Seamico rates NTS a sell.

text.p: Seamico Research said on Thursday it rated NTS Steel Group a sell because of its high debt-to-equity ratio which stood at over 400 percent at the end of second quarter this year.

Seamico said in a research report that NTS Steel, which faces depressed steel bar and wire rod prices and production problems, would find it difficult to service its debt obligations using only funds from operations.

Borrowing or issuing more equity remains the only method for the firm to stay afloat, Seamico said. Considering the company's current high gearing, a cash call appeared very likely and this would further dilute its per-share earnings.
NTS Steel recently signed a contract to supply 75,000 tonnes of steel bars to a consortium for the construction of an expressway in Bangkok.
NTS's stock price is expected to react positively to the signing of this contract. But this pesented a good opportunity to sell, Seamico said.
